Name: Teams Controls
Author: Michael Palermiti
Description: Meeting controls for Microsoft Teams on Mac, with live state on every key. Works through macOS Accessibility, since Teams retired its local control API.

Actions.Name: Mute
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle your microphone. Lit while your mic is live. On a Stream Deck+ dial: hold to talk, turn to mute or unmute.

TriggerDescription.Push: Tap to toggle, hold to talk
TriggerDescription.Rotate: Right to unmute, left to mute

Actions.Name: Camera
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle your camera. Lit while it is on.

Actions.Name: Background blur
Actions.Tooltip: Background blur: not supported yet on current Teams.

Actions.Name: Raise hand
Actions.Tooltip: Raise or lower your hand (through the React menu).

Actions.Name: Leave
Actions.Tooltip: Leave the meeting. Red while you are in one.

Actions.Name: React
Actions.Tooltip: Send a reaction to the meeting.

Actions.Name: Chat
Actions.Tooltip: Open or close meeting chat. Lit when there are unread messages.

Actions.Name: Share
Actions.Tooltip: Open the share tray, or stop sharing while you are presenting. Lit while sharing.
